name: economist-podcast-studio
description: Source-linked Economist article extraction, conversational podcast scripts, Azure audio with default background music, and static-slide video rendering.

interface.longDescription: A local production plugin for extracting one selected Economist article, writing source-bounded conversational scripts, generating Azure Speech audio and captions with default background music, and rendering static-slide podcast videos.
defaultPrompt: Extract one selected Economist article from a PDF.
Turn a verified Economist article into a natural podcast script.
Generate the selected podcast audio, captions, and static-slide video.
